label: Equilibrium baseline
description: No shocks; 2 percent inflation target, neutral real rate and stable structural unemployment.

label: Demand boom
description: Hypothetical positive demand pulses; no forecast is implied.

label: Adverse supply shock
description: Hypothetical temporary cost and capacity pressure, not a policy-controlled input.

label: Funding stress
description: Hypothetical funding need with eligible collateral and a separate solvency-risk wedge.

label: Weakly anchored inflation
description: Hypothetical above-target inflation with low initial credibility.

label: Lower-bound slump
description: Hypothetical weak activity at the modeled policy-rate floor.

label: Recurring crises (advanced)
description: Fictional recurring demand, supply and funding episodes across a 60-year career. Future crises remain unknown; incidence is not historically calibrated.
